Professional Summary
Results-driven finance professional with progressive FP&A and financial modeling experience across logistics, gaming, and SaaS sectors. Skilled at building budgeting and forecasting processes, delivering insights through dashboards, and automating analysis to support strategic decisions.

Technical Skills
Financial Modeling, FP&A, Microsoft Excel, PowerBI, Linux, Git

Work Experience

- Built and maintained monthly FP&A processes using Microsoft Excel and PowerBI to produce P&L, cash flow and variance reports for senior leadership, supporting a 10% reduction in working capital days.
- Developed driver-based financial models to evaluate route optimization and pricing scenarios, enabling scenario comparisons that informed a 7% improvement in per-shipment margin.
- Automated recurring data reconciliations and KPI reports using Excel macros and Linux-based scripts, reducing report preparation time by 40%.

Financial Analyst, Dream11 (Feb 2023 - Nov 2025)
- Created detailed financial models and rolling forecasts to support product monetization experiments, driving a data-backed roadmap that increased ARPU in targeted cohorts by 12%.
- Partnered with cross-functional teams to define and track KPIs, delivering weekly PowerBI dashboards and ad-hoc Excel analyses for leadership and product managers.
- Led quarterly budgeting and variance analysis cycles (FP&A), identifying cost-to-serve efficiencies and contributing to a 5% reduction in marketing spend inefficiency.

FP&A Manager, Freshworks (May 2022 - Jan 2023)
- Managed FP&A cadence for a product line, producing monthly financial packages and board-ready PowerBI dashboards to highlight revenue trends and margin levers.
- Built and validated financial models in Excel for go-to-market scenarios and subscription pricing changes, enabling faster decision-making on customer acquisition investments.
- Streamlined forecasting workflows and version control using Git for model governance and leveraged Linux-based automation to accelerate data ingestion.
